inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Detect External User Subscription Write in Azure

properties.description: This detection identifies successful subscription write operations in Azure performed by external users (#EXT# accounts), indicating possible unauthorized configuration changes or cross-tenant modifications requiring immediate investigation.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Detect External User Subscription Write in Azure
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue == "Microsoft.Subscription/subscriptions/write"
| where ActivityStatus == "Succeeded"
| extend CallerUpn = tostring(parse_json(Authorization).claims.upn)
| where CallerUpn contains "#EXT#"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    OperationName,
    OperationNameValue,
    ActivityStatus,
    Caller,
    CallerUpn,
    SubscriptionId,
    _ResourceId,
    ResourceGroup,
    Resource,
    CallerIpAddress,
    CorrelationId,
    TenantId
| extend AccountCustomEntity = CallerUpn
| extend IPCustomEntity = CallerIpAddress
